fact: The head of Libya’s General Authority for Monitoring Media Content said on 12 November 2026 that its professional code bans using AI for deepfakes or disinformation, that its monitoring teams have recorded breaches such as fabricated images of guests, and that it is preparing an AI-use guide.
title: توصيات بسن تشريعات رقمية ومواجهة التضليل - مؤتمر الاعلام بجامعة الزيتونة يضع خارطة طريق لمواكبة الذكاء الاصطناعي
